findings.text: The regex pattern `$CONTROL_CHAR\[[0-9;]+m` requires at least one digit or semicolon between `[` and `m`, so ANSI reset code `\033[m` (no parameters) will not match and will remain unremoved in the output.
The substitution `${output//${BASH_REMATCH[0]}/}` treats BASH_REMATCH[0] as a glob pattern, so ANSI codes containing `[`, `]`, `*`, or `?` may be interpreted incorrectly and fail to be removed.
Non-ANSI escape characters (e.g., `\033` not followed by `[...m`) are no longer escaped to ``, potentially producing invalid XML if such characters appear in test output.
